name: Compliance & Governance
summary: Simplify compliance, audits, and risk management.
description: Compliance and governance UI UX design for GRC, audit and risk software: control libraries, evidence workflows and risk dashboards teams keep up to date.
image_alt: Team reviewing documents, compliance and governance
overview:
Compliance software has a hard job. It has to satisfy auditors and regulators, yet most people using it are busy managers who would rather be doing something else. When the tool is confusing, evidence goes missing, controls drift and every audit turns into a scramble. My job is to make the work obvious: what is due, who owns it and what is still at risk.

I work with founders and product teams on GRC and compliance products, from early prototypes to a design system engineers can build from directly. My experience designing dashboards and risk tools, such as the KADUU intelligence workspace, shapes how I handle dense status data, ownership and clear history.

challenges.title: Evidence chasing
challenges.text: Collecting proof from many owners by email and spreadsheet makes every audit slow and stressful.

challenges.title: Framework overlap
challenges.text: One control often maps to several standards, and the interface has to show that without confusing people.

challenges.title: Dense status data
challenges.text: Risk registers and control lists hold hundreds of items, each with an owner, a status and a due date.

challenges.title: Occasional users
challenges.text: Many people log in only to complete one task a quarter, so every flow has to explain itself.

faqs.question: Have you designed compliance software before?
faqs.answer: My closest published work is in risk and monitoring tools: KADUU, a dark web intelligence workspace for understanding digital exposure and risk, and Nimbus, a monitoring dashboard built around priority and context. Both solve the same problem compliance tools have, showing what needs attention first.

faqs.question: Do I need to explain the frameworks to you?
faqs.answer: A short walkthrough of the standards your customers care about helps. I ask a lot of questions early, then design around your control model rather than a generic one.

faqs.question: Can you design for both compliance teams and occasional users?
faqs.answer: Yes. I design a detailed workspace for compliance teams and a simpler, task-focused path for owners who only need to upload evidence or approve a policy.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing design system?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can extend and clean up an existing system, or create one from scratch with tokens and components that match your codebase.

faqs.question: How do we start?
faqs.answer: Send me a short brief through the contact page. We will have a call about your product, users and timeline, and I will come back with a plan and quote.
